verdict.rationale: Authy documents automatic multi-device sync across phone and tablet with encrypted backup. Community users corroborate multi-device use and key syncing between devices on the same account. The 'computer' part is concretely undercut: docs list macOS, Windows, and Linux apps, but multiple users report that Twilio EOL'd and removed the desktop apps, so simultaneous phone/tablet/computer availability is not reliably delivered. Missing for 10: current desktop/computer sync support, first-party detail on how sync works and its conflict behavior.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: On any device. Your phone, tablet, even your Apple Watch.
I started using Authy long ago because it supports multiple devices
This allowed them to sync the keys between devices within the same account.
Now they are EOL'ing desktop apps
